title: Marguerite and the Inventory
author: Quentin Sandoval
blurb: Isandro Thornbury, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then the last speaker of a language asks for one final student — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it before the house sale closes.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
